failing_exception: TypeError: RecordPermissions.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'required_clearance'
root_cause: The inline Python test harness in .github/workflows/canary.yml incorrectly attempted to pass required_clearance to RecordPermissions. Under the authoritative ATLAS model (novastack.models.RecordPermissions), permissions model access control lists (allowed_roles, allowed_departments, allowed_teams, allowed_user_ids), while data clearance/classification is tracked separately via classification on EvidenceItem and SourceRecord. Furthermore, the inline conversion helper dict_to_evidence_pkg and inline synthetic fixtures in Probes 4 and 5 did not supply all required positional arguments for EvidenceItem and EvidencePackage, creating secondary fixture failure hazards.

remediation_details.evidence_item_contract: Standardized on full 24-attribute signature matching scripts/run_phase_05_m8_experiment.py and novastack.evidence.EvidenceItem
remediation_details.evidence_package_contract: Supplied required package_id, evaluation_id, query, tenant_id, user_context, selected_evidence, excluded_evidence, conflicts, provenance_graph, resolution_decisions, statistics
remediation_details.probe_4_and_5_helpers: Introduced make_evidence_item inline factory in canary.yml to cleanly generate synthetic multi-tenant and adversarial test items
